name: Putra Dosha
desc: Putra Dosha is formed when the 5th house, its lord, or Jupiter (the significator for children) is afflicted by malefic planets. This dosha can result in difficulties related to childbirth, delay in progeny, miscarriages, or challenges in the health and wellbeing of children. It is considered a karmic indication from past lives or due to imbalance in planetary influences affecting the house of progeny.
remedies:
Chant Santan Gopal Mantra regularly
Worship Lord Krishna and offer Tulsi leaves
Perform puja or homa for Jupiter (Guru) on Thursdays
Feed cows, donate yellow items (like turmeric, bananas, or clothes) to Brahmins on Thursdays
Seek blessings of parents, teachers, and spiritual guides
